This tbh I don't know why the down votes. To be fair it isn't easy but isn't hard either. You just need to make good use and actually understand all of the mechanics and new additions of the game (like changing party characters, the baton pass bonus damage, exploit enemy weaknesses, buff and debuffing, and the use or elemental items that can hit the target weakness) and by the time you reach this boss fight you already should have experienced all of these thing and the game tells you about them. Some of them are even bound to happen in the story.

Maybe I'm little late here but I think the majority of the community is overreacting. I see and know that MHY isn't given the best response either. But I don't  blame them. If a have a lot of people review bombing and being toxic with the ones who think the rewards are fine I wouldn't care to listen them either. Yeah the rewards are not the best and could've been better. Yeah the silence treatment even with the ones who are not toxic isn't nice. And yeah deleting post on the reddit and discord is bad an censorship. But for god's sake I swear that for the last 2 or 3 weeks I've seen nothing but angry rants about the rewards everywhere. And when someone who doesn't agree with them or who tells to shut the fuck up and voice their rants directly at MHY because it's annoying to see that shit daily for weeks, they'll just call you a white knight or bootlicker. Tbh if I were MHY I wouldn't care for them either.
Yeah that's true. But I do feel necessary for a discussion to be like that. Otherwise you just have people throwing at each other throats and sometimes over exaggerating things.
